chains.name: Herd Mentality
chains.description: When an allied Sinner with [Credit] already stacked to the maximum gains [Credit] again, it is randomly distributed to other allied Sinners with [Deception].

chains.name: Energy Boost I
chains.description: At the start of the battle, Parfait gains 10 Energy.

chains.name: Economic Bubble
chains.description: When [Deception] is active on allied Sinners, if [Credit] is stacked to the maximum, the effect is additionally increased by 30%. Additionally, for each stack of [Credit] gained by allied Sinners, Parfait's Energy recovery speed increases by 3%, stacking up to 18 times,

chains.name: Illusory Liquidity
chains.description: When allied Sinners with [Credit] deal damage, for each 1 Core Damage applied by that attack, recovers 1 Energy. If that attack breaks an [Umbra Core] and Parfait has unlocked the [Leverage Doubling] effect, recovers 2 Energy instead. This effect can trigger up to 3 times per second.

chains.name: Energy Boost II
chains.description: At the start of the battle, Parfait gains 10 Energy.

[Credit]: Each stack grants the carrier ?% increased damage against elite and boss units, stacking up to 12 times and lasting until the end of the battle.
